:::{#def-log-odds}
#### Log-odds (also called the logit)

The **log-odds**, also called the **logit**, of an event $A$
with probability $\P(A) \in (0, 1)$
are the natural logarithm of its [odds](#def-odds)
[@wikipedia_logit]:

$$\logodds \eqdef \logf{\odds} = \logf{\frac{\P(A)}{1 - \P(A)}} \in \reals.$$

:::
